blind.description: A wooden torture rack device constructed with a rectangular timber frame, four vertical corner posts with dark iron corner brackets, and a flat wooden plank bed in the center. At both the head and foot ends are horizontal winding rollers wrapped with rope/cordage that connect via ropes to metal cuffs/shackles resting on the bed. One end features a four-spoke wooden and iron crank wheel for tightening tension. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted wooden textures, dark metal fittings, and light tan rope windings. It stands stably on four post legs directly on the floor with no extra base.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden table-like structure oriented vertically, flanked by four corner post tops. Two horizontal cylindrical rollers with tan rope windings sit near top and bottom, with ropes connecting inward to pairs of metal shackles on the wooden plank surface. A four-spoke turning crank protrudes from the bottom-right corner.
blind.height_vs_figure: Reaches roughly knee-to-thigh height (about 1.5 to 2 feet tall), roughly 2 feet wide, and about 5 to 5.5 feet long compared to the 5 ft 9 in figure.
